Name: Furry Farmers (Fashion Sense Port)
Author: Lavalink07
Description:
[center][size=6][b]The Original Mod is [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7618][color=#e69138][u][b]Furry Farmer[/b][/u][/color][/url] ﻿[b]by [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3354659][b][u]Krystedez[/u][/b][/url][b] and their Team[/b][/size]﻿

[color=#ffffff]This is just Furry Farmer but Ported to Fashion Sense for people that wish to play with others. All species are ported to fashion sense including Male/Female.

[/color][color=#00ffff][size=4][u]Instructions[/u][/size][/color]

[size=3]1. Download the Required Mods That Are Listed[/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=3][u](If you are wanting an easy way for everyone to change their species)
[/u][/size][/color]
[b]2a. Go to The Mod Settings Menu on the Main Menu Screen. (Located In The Bottom Left)[/b]
[b]3a. Deselect Require Hand Mirror.[/b]
[b]4a. Bind Hand Mirror Shortcut Key to a Button You Prefer.[/b]
[b]5a. Save and Quit Out of the Settings Menu.[/b]
[b]6a. Then Load/Host a Save.[/b]

[color=#ffff00][size=3][u](If you are just starting a save and want a more ingame way of changing it)
[/u][/size][/color]
[b]2b. Create/Host a New Farm.[/b]
[b]3b. Select Start With Mirror.[/b]
[b]4b. Go to Your Mail Box and Collect The Mirror.[/b]

[color=#00ffff][size=4](Creating Your Fluffy Farmer)
[/size][/color]
[b]1. Press The Key You Set For The Hand Mirror / Left Click With The Hand Mirror.[/b]
[b]2. Go To Body and Find The Species You Want. (You WILL see both the Legs and Arms Vanish)[/b]
[b]3. Go to Sleeves and Select the One That Matches Your Species[/b]
[b]4. Go To Legs and Select "Default (Tall)" (These come with base Fashion Sense)[/b]
[b]5. Change the Color Of Everything If You Haven't Already and Have Fun![/b]

I would like to add more to this but, I am NOT a good artist. If you want me to add something, let me know. (I may not respond fast depending on of if I am looking at Nexus or Not)
This is also technically my first mod I have ever posted, so please let me know if I have messed anything up. [b][u]And if you find a bug or broken visual, please let me know in the Posts tab.[/u][/b]

[b][u]If requested by the Author I will take this down.[/u][/b][/center]
[s]*All of them asides from the Protogen, I haven't gotten to them yet[/s] [b]Added in 0.9.2. You will find the Visor in Accessories.
[/b]
**[s]Had issue with the Colors of Players' Arms being cloned from the Client that used the same arm (Or even scrolled over). So I instead made multiple copies of the same arm for each species. If you have Color issues with the Arms, just have everyone create their character in the save and use separate arms, then have everyone Sleep. And Then Reload The Game.[/s] [b]Fixed in 0.9.2. You will need to set the arm's color separately from the body.[/b]

Downloads.Description: Fixed The Pink Tint That I Missed On the Sleeves.
